page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with a library stamp in the middle of the text block. The printed lines are faint and mirrored, showing through from the reverse of the leaf. No margins, no running head, no page number. Blocks in reading order: the title lines from top to bottom, then the imprint lines at the foot.
page.notes: The title page is set in large type but the visible letters are mirrored and faint, showing through from the back of the leaf. Only a few words can be made out with any confidence (DIATRIBE, DE, MINISTERIO, ECCLESIASTICO, and a name in the middle lines), so the remaining lines are marked illegible rather than guessed. The Roman numerals in the second title line are not reliable. The circular stamp "STADTBIBLIOTHEK * ZÜRICH" with a coat of arms is a library stamp and is left out. A small mark at the top left corner is not a page number and is left out. The imprint at the foot is too faint to read.
